title.value: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network
title.justification: The title directly states the focal topic of the paper, which is the use of Graph Neural Networks for handover parameter configuration in cellular networks.
title.quote: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network

extractions.description: This paper presents a novel learning-based framework for optimizing handover parameters in cellular networks using auto-grouping graph convolutional networks. The framework aims to address the complexity of dependencies between neighboring cells by introducing a local multi-objective optimization strategy, enhancing network throughput, and potentially reducing human intervention and costs.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper mentions its contribution towards United Nations Sustainable Development Goals by improving telecommunications infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, and fostering innovation.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Thus, improving the cellular network has both economic and social impact towards achieving United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs) ... it can highly contribute to enhancing infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, fostering innovation, responsible consumption, enabling sustainable cities and communities, and promoting decent work and economic growth.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing the performance of cellular networks, which is closely related to energy efficiency—a key aspect of Climate Change Mitigation.
primary_category.quote: The mobile communication enabled by cellular networks is one of the main foundations of our modern society. Optimizing the performance of cellular networks and providing massive connectivity with improved coverage and user experience has a considerable social and economic impact on our daily life.

secondary_categories.justification: By automating the optimization of cellular networks, the framework can provide high-quality internet access to underserved areas, which can benefit developing regions by enabling applications like remote education and health monitoring.
secondary_categories.quote: It opens up the potential for high-quality internet access to geographical areas that are currently under-served by the cellular network. Besides, this framework can bring new possibilities for important applications to under-developed regions including online education, health monitoring devices by improving their real time connection.

primary_sub_category.justification: While inherently about cellular networks, the paper's optimization efforts align with energy efficiency practices. This includes reducing the need for manual network management and improving operational efficiencies.
primary_sub_category.quote: This performance relies heavily on the configuration of the network parameters. However, with the massive increase in both the size and complexity of cellular networks, network management, especially parameter configuration, is becoming complicated.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The implementation of more efficient network management can be indirectly related to optimizing energy use, thus supporting renewable energy deployment strategies by ensuring more efficient infrastructures.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Moreover, it can highly contribute to enhancing infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, fostering innovation, responsible consumption ...

applications.value: Improving operation of communication systems using AI
applications.justification: The proposed method offers advancements in network optimization and management through AI, which can significantly improve telecommunications systems.
applications.quote: In this work, we propose a learning-based framework for handover parameter configuration.
